cands: We first read a table of {{n_sent}} sentences from the four papers and compared the score contribution of each sentence with its features. Semicolons, contrast framing, advice, verdict words and colon set-ups went with higher scores, and "we", short sentences and citations went with lower ones. From this table we wrote rule 78 of the writing rules in road-to-robotics. A feature that goes with a high score can travel with something else, such as a long list of numbers. This paper changes one feature at a time and scores the result.
